196	def _neuralgrok_canonical_mv(grad, opt_obj, step, p_before=None):
197	    """The (m, v, p_after) the NeuralGrok tail MUST produce, by the canonical header math.
198	
199	    Transcribes csrc/algorithms/neuralgrok.h (the SINGLE source the kernel's
200	    apply_optimizer<NeuralGrok> calls) — the gate's docstring defines its reference as
201	    exactly this header math:
202	        psi   = sum_j psi_W2[j] * relu(psi_W1[j]*|g| + psi_b1[j]) + psi_b2   (kPsiHidden=16)
203	        g_amp = (psi*alpha + beta) * g
204	        m     = beta1*m_prev + (1-beta1)*g_amp        (m_prev = 0 at step 1, zero-init cache)
205	        v     = beta2*v_prev + (1-beta2)*g_amp^2
206	        update= (m/bc1) / (sqrt(v/bc2) + eps);  p_after = p - lr*(update + wd*p)   (AdamW tail)
207	    computed in fp64 on the SAME captured TC-reduced grad and the SAME psi weights the
208	    kernel read (opt_obj.psi_pack). Returns flat fp32 (m, v, p_after) for the whole param
209	    vector; p_after is None when p_before is None (the (1b)-only call shape).
210	
211	    RE-ANCHOR (task #10): the eager per-op neuralgrok_fused_step CUDA kernel is being
212	    DELETED, so BOTH (1a) params and (1b) m/v are now anchored to THIS ground-truth fp64
213	    transcription of neuralgrok.h — the same single source the kernel's apply_optimizer<
214	    NeuralGrok> compiles from. The kernel matches this canonical math to ~2.7e-7. (1a) used
215	    to compare the live eager opt.step(); with the eager path gone, the AdamW tail here IS
216	    the (1a) reference. bf16 stays the compute precision; fp64 is the yardstick.
217	    """
218	    dev = grad.device
219	    g64 = grad.double()
220	    # GLOBAL grad-norm clip — neuralgrok.h's tail clips the reduced grad (kernel P2.5,
221	    # st.clip_coef) BEFORE psi+amp. Apply the SAME clip to the reference so it tracks the
222	    # kernel when the clip FIRES (global grad-norm > grad_clip, e.g. seed 7); inert
223	    # (coef=1) when norm<=clip. total_norm = sqrt(Σ g²) over the reduced grad == the
224	    # kernel's P2.5 norm.
225	    _gclip = float(opt_obj.param_groups[0].get("grad_clip", 0.0))
226	    if _gclip > 0.0:
227	        _tn = g64.norm().item()
228	        if _tn > _gclip:
229	            g64 = g64 * (_gclip / (_tn + 1e-6))
230	    ag = g64.abs()
231	    pack = opt_obj.psi_pack(device=dev).double()
232	    H = (pack.numel() - 1) // 3
233	    W1 = pack[0:H]; b1 = pack[H:2 * H]; W2 = pack[2 * H:3 * H]; b2 = pack[3 * H]
234	    # psi = sum_j W2[j]*relu(W1[j]*|g| + b1[j]) + b2  (per element)
235	    hid = torch.relu(ag.unsqueeze(1) * W1.reshape(1, H) + b1.reshape(1, H))   # [N,H]
236	    psi = (hid * W2.reshape(1, H)).sum(1) + b2                                # [N]
237	    grp = opt_obj.param_groups[0]
238	    alpha = float(grp["alpha"]); beta = float(grp["beta"])
239	    beta1, beta2 = float(grp["betas"][0]), float(grp["betas"][1])
240	    g_amp = (psi * alpha + beta) * g64
241	    # step 1 from zero-init moments (the kernel's state cache zero-inits [m|v|extra]).
242	    m = (1.0 - beta1) * g_amp
243	    v = (1.0 - beta2) * g_amp * g_amp
244	    p_after = None
245	    if p_before is not None:
246	        # AdamW tail (the (1a) reference). bc1=1-β1, bc2=1-β2 at t=1.
247	        lr = float(grp.get("lr", 1e-3)); eps = float(grp.get("eps", 1e-8))
248	        wd = float(grp.get("weight_decay", 0.0))
249	        bc1 = 1.0 - beta1; bc2 = 1.0 - beta2
250	        pb = p_before.double().to(dev)
251	        update = (m / bc1) / (torch.sqrt(v / bc2) + eps)
252	        p_after = (pb - lr * (update + wd * pb)).float()
253	    return m.float(), v.float(), p_after

212	    N, H, hd = qh.shape
213	    M = kh.shape[0]
214	    neg_inf = -np.inf
215	
216	    # ---- selected-key (or all-key) block ----
217	    if sel_idx_arr is None:
218	        # HCA: every one of the M key rows is a key for every query.
219	        # logits_sel[t, j, h] = (qh[t,h] . kh[j,h]) * scale
220	        logits_sel = np.einsum("thd,jhd->tjh", qh, kh, optimize=True) * scale  # [N,M,H]
221	        val_sel = vh                                                            # [M,H,hd]
222	        sel_gather = None
223	        sel_valid = None  # all valid
224	    else:
225	        sel = sel_idx_arr                                   # [N, topk] int
226	        sel_valid = (sel >= 0) & (sel < M)                  # [N, topk]
227	        sel_clamped = np.where(sel_valid, sel, 0)           # safe gather index
228	        # gather keys/values for each (t, slot): [N, topk, H, hd]
229	        kh_sel = kh[sel_clamped]
230	        val_sel = vh[sel_clamped]                           # [N, topk, H, hd]
231	        # logits[t, slot, h] = sum_hd qh[t,h,:] * kh_sel[t,slot,h,:]
232	        logits_sel = np.einsum("thd,tshd->tsh", qh, kh_sel, optimize=True) * scale  # [N,topk,H]
233	        logits_sel = np.where(sel_valid[:, :, None], logits_sel, neg_inf)
234	        sel_gather = val_sel
235	
236	    # ---- causal window block ----
237	    W = D.csa_window
238	    t_idx = np.arange(N)
239	    # window rows for query t are [t-W+1, ..., t]; columns ordered ascending.
240	    win_cols = t_idx[:, None] - np.arange(W - 1, -1, -1)[None, :]   # [N, W]
241	    win_valid = win_cols >= 0                                       # [N, W]
242	    win_clamped = np.where(win_valid, win_cols, 0)
243	    winkh_w = winkh[win_clamped]                                    # [N, W, H, hd]
244	    winvh_w = winvh[win_clamped]
245	    logits_win = np.einsum("thd,twhd->twh", qh, winkh_w, optimize=True) * scale  # [N,W,H]
246	    logits_win = np.where(win_valid[:, :, None], logits_win, neg_inf)
247	
248	    # ---- combined numerically-stable softmax over the union ----
249	    if sel_idx_arr is None:
250	        m_sel = logits_sel.max(axis=1)                              # [N,H]
251	    else:
252	        m_sel = logits_sel.max(axis=1)                              # [N,H] (>=neg_inf)
253	    m_win = logits_win.max(axis=1)                                  # [N,H]
254	    m = np.maximum(m_sel, m_win)                                    # [N,H] global max
255	    m_safe = np.where(np.isfinite(m), m, 0.0)                       # avoid -inf - -inf
256	
257	    p_sel = np.exp(logits_sel - m_safe[:, None, :])                # [N,S,H]; masked->0
258	    p_win = np.exp(logits_win - m_safe[:, None, :])                # [N,W,H]; masked->0
259	
260	    rd = p_sel.sum(axis=1) + p_win.sum(axis=1)                      # [N,H]
261	
262	    # numerator: sum_s p_sel * val_sel  +  sum_w p_win * winvh_w
263	    if sel_idx_arr is None:
264	        num = np.einsum("tjh,jhd->thd", p_sel, val_sel, optimize=True)        # [N,H,hd]
265	    else:
266	        num = np.einsum("tsh,tshd->thd", p_sel, sel_gather, optimize=True)    # [N,H,hd]
267	    num = num + np.einsum("twh,twhd->thd", p_win, winvh_w, optimize=True)     # [N,H,hd]
268	
269	    rd_safe = np.where(rd > 0.0, rd, 1.0)
270	    ctx = np.where(rd[:, :, None] > 0.0, num / rd_safe[:, :, None], num)      # [N,H,hd]
271	    return ctx.reshape(N, D.d_model)

647	    compressed keys) — NOT the meta-net math — and the production kernel itself
648	    computes this indexer in bf16/fp32 on the GPU, so doing the score matmul + top-k
649	    on the GPU (or in fp32 on the CPU) is faithful to the kernel. The fp64
650	    ground-truth that matters (attention weights, GRU/PEER/Adam) is untouched, and

656	    Fallback: chunked numpy argpartition (fp32 scores, bounded peak memory) when
657	    CUDA/torch is unavailable (e.g. the standalone CPU `--selftest`)."""

675	    # --- numpy fallback: chunked top-k via argpartition (no full O(Nc·logNc) sort) ---

677	    kI32T = np.ascontiguousarray(kI.T, dtype=np.float32)
678	    inv32 = np.float32(inv_sqrt_rk)
